claim_boundary: HEEP/EMAS artifacts are discovery-only until a live ensemble runner produces runtime receipts.
External GitHub skills may enter Safe-Candidate intake only; they do not auto-promote to runtime default.
Public benchmark and runtime apply gates remain separate and fail-closed.

metrics.consensus_score: role coverage ratio for the proposed assembly
metrics.premium_factor: extra skill count divided by quality lift; lower is better
metrics.quality_lift: dry-run score delta until live ensemble evidence exists
metrics.synergy_factor: ensemble role coverage minus solo role coverage

Mode A (Solo).purpose: Primary skill only; lowest coordination cost.

Mode C (Swarm).purpose: Scout, Logic, and Audit roles assembled for consensus.
